violated_contract: An identity or equality check over persisted records must compare only the fields that define identity. When the check compares a whole model minus an exclude list, every field added later joins the identity by default; records written before the field existed store it as absent, so every replay of an older record is reported as a conflict for a source that did not change.
canonical_prevention: Classify every field of a persisted model that takes part in an identity check as identity, metadata, or state, compare with an include list of identity fields, and keep a unit test that fails when a new field is unclassified.
